origins.section: Planners Need a Plan They Can Act On and Explain
Finance Needs Spend by Year That Matches What Was Authorized
Regulators Need Commitments Kept and a Result Anyone Can Reproduce

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-left-out: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-left-out: 'A ratio cannot explain a selection; only the model's rows can.' P002 is out because 'whose replacement P001 is funded'.
recorded.prompt:q-total-under: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-total-under: **Spend by year, never only a total.** A plan within its five-year total can still break a year.
recorded.prompt:q-rerun-differs: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-rerun-differs: 'A snapshot fixes the inputs, but solver version, thread count and time limits can still change the result when a model has several optimal plans.'
